purpose: Pre-treatment availability and timing completeness check only. No causal effect estimated.
scope: Completed HVFHV bookings between Greenpoint and Long Island City taxi zones; actual route and passenger count unobserved.

years.timestamp_filter_note: Nonnegative request-to-pickup, positive ride, total at most4h. Threshold is feasibility cleaning, not analysis preregistration.

limitations: Both windows predate the southern McGuinness late2024 redesign.
Zone-level exposure cannot prove use of the redesigned road.
Request-to-dropoff omits access/egress and canceled/unserved requests.
Completed bookings are not people, vehicles or all travel; shared rows can overlap.
Same dates of month have different weekday composition; no year-to-year outcome comparison made.
